description: This file manages plugin registry state, including setting, retrieving, pinning, and resolving plugin registries for HTTP routes, channels, and the overall plugin system. It also tracks imported plugin IDs and provides test reset functionality.

methods.name: recordImportedPluginId
methods.description: Adds a plugin ID to the set of imported plugin IDs tracked in the current process.

methods.name: setActivePluginRegistry
methods.description: Sets the active plugin registry, updates version, and synchronizes HTTP route and channel surfaces.

methods.name: getActivePluginRegistry
methods.description: Returns the current active plugin registry or null if none is set.

methods.name: requireActivePluginRegistry
methods.description: Ensures an active plugin registry exists, creating an empty one if necessary.

methods.name: pinActivePluginHttpRouteRegistry
methods.description: Pins the specified plugin registry to the HTTP route surface.

methods.name: releasePinnedPluginHttpRouteRegistry
methods.description: Releases the pinned plugin registry from the HTTP route surface.

methods.name: getActivePluginHttpRouteRegistry
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP route plugin registry or the active registry if none is pinned.

methods.name: getActivePluginHttpRouteRegistryVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the HTTP route plugin registry.

methods.name: requireActivePluginHttpRouteRegistry
methods.description: Ensures an HTTP route plugin registry exists, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: resolveActivePluginHttpRouteRegistry
methods.description: Returns the HTTP route registry or fallback based on certain conditions.

methods.name: pinActivePluginChannelRegistry
methods.description: Pins the specified plugin registry to the channel surface.

methods.name: releasePinnedPluginChannelRegistry
methods.description: Releases the pinned plugin registry from the channel surface.

methods.name: getActivePluginChannelRegistry
methods.description: Returns the current channel plugin registry or the active registry if none is pinned.

methods.name: getActivePluginChannelRegistryVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the channel plugin registry.

methods.name: requireActivePluginChannelRegistry
methods.description: Ensures a channel plugin registry exists, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: getActivePluginRegistryKey
methods.description: Returns the key associated with the active plugin registry.

methods.name: getActivePluginRuntimeSubagentMode
methods.description: Returns the current runtime subagent mode.

methods.name: getActivePluginRegistryVersion
methods.description: Returns the version number of the active plugin registry.

methods.name: listImportedRuntimePluginIds
methods.description: Lists plugin IDs imported during the current process, including loaded plugins and registry plugins.

methods.name: resetPluginRuntimeStateForTest
methods.description: Resets the plugin runtime state for testing purposes.
